## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company being rated." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `AdjustedPriceTarget` | double | The current price target adjusted for stock splits and dividends. | REST |
| `Analyst` | String | The name of the individual analyst who issued the rating. | REST |
| `BenzingaAnalystId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this analyst. | REST |
| `BenzingaCalendarUrl` | String | A link to the Benzinga calendar page for this ticker | REST |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this firm. | REST |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. | REST |
| `BenzingaNewsUrl` | String | A link to the Benzinga articles page for this ticker | REST |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company being rated. | REST |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 currency code in which the price target is denominated. | REST |
| `Date` | String | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the rating was issued. | REST |
| `Firm` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the rating. | REST |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the earnings event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). | REST |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the rating was last updated in the system. | REST |
| `Notes` | String | Additional context or commentary. | REST |
| `PreviousAdjustedPriceTarget` | double | The previous price target adjusted for stock splits and dividends. | REST |
| `PreviousPriceTarget` | double | The previous price target set by the analyst. | REST |
| `PreviousRating` | String | The previous rating set by the analyst. | REST |
| `PricePercentChange` | double | The percentage change in price target if price target and previous price target exists | REST |
| `PriceTarget` | double | The current price target set by the analyst. | REST |
| `PriceTargetAction` | String | The description of the directional change in price target. Possible values include: raises, lowers, maintains, announces, sets. | REST |
| `Rating` | String | The current rating set by the analyst. | REST |
| `RatingAction` | String | The description of the change in rating from the firm's last rating. Possible values include: downgrades, maintains, reinstates, reiterates, upgrades, assumes, initiates_coverage_on, terminates_coverage_on, removes, suspends, firm_dissolved. | REST |
| `Time` | String | The time (formatted as 24-hour HH:MM:SS UTC) when the rating was issued. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (in code or in the settings file, as `unreadable_symbols: raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
